_info: Unit stats. hp = health, dmg = damage per hit, reach = attack range in m, speed = m/s, cd = delay between attacks in s, armor = share of damage absorbed, radius = body radius in m, palette_row = palette texture row (cloth colour). heal_combat = the priest heals on his own only when an awake enemy is within this many m (no healing between battle phases). target_priority = whom the hero prefers to attack ('ranged' = bowmen). mounted = cavalry (spearmen deal dmg_vs_mounted against it). ignores = terrain that does not slow the unit ('les' = forest). ability = ability key (abilities), abilities = the class's 3 abilities (for swapping), stat_weights = how much each stat matters to the hero (1–3). model = class GLB (otherwise the shared knight SK_Knight), weapon_model = weapon GLB (grip in the fist, hand bone Z axis), weapon_bone = hand bone (default hand_r), offhand_model = off-hand weapon GLB (offhand_bone, default hand_l), projectile = look of the shot (svetlo = the priest's golden light, otherwise an arrow), projectile_model = arrow GLB (tip along model Y), bow_string = bow string ends [x, y, z] in bow model space (Godot; the game draws the string, when drawn it runs through the right hand), mount_model = horse GLB (cavalier), rider_offset = where the rider sits relative to the horse origin [x, y, z] (Godot, m), mount_anims = horse animations (idle, walk = trot, gallop = during Charge, hit, death), mount_walk_speed = speed at which the trot plays at 1×, anims = animation names (idle, walk, attack, ability, hit, death; missing = knight's).

foe_skills._info: Commander abilities. The commander announces it (warn, a red circle in the UI) and winds up for windup s; a stun interrupts the windup (then half the cd). first = when the first time, cd = how often. kind: zone (at the spot with the most heroes within range: dmg in radius, then burns burn_t s for burn_dps), shot (at the most wounded hero within range: dmg; misses when the hero takes cover or leaves range + 2 m), smash (around himself in radius: dmg), rally (enemies within radius attack for duration s × dmg_mult). The death of a leader breaks morale.

pochoden.name: Torch
pochoden.warn: The Burner throws a torch! Get out of the circle

povel.name: At them!
povel.warn: The Sergeant rallies his men! Stun him or hold on

rozmach.name: Sweep
rozmach.warn: The Captain winds up a sweep! Step away from him

battle_modes._info: Battle type (scenario.mode). Changes the enemy and the shape of the battle, not the heroes (they act on orders): utok = the enemy holds positions and waits, stret = the enemy comes at you, obrana = the enemy attacks in waves.

utok.name: Assault
utok.desc: The enemy holds positions. Send your heroes at their groups.

stret.name: Clash
stret.desc: The enemy comes at you. Place your heroes where you want to meet them.

obrana.name: Defense
obrana.desc: You hold the place, the enemy attacks in waves. Place your heroes where they will come.

camera._info: Fixed-angle camera (decision 30.10.2026), default values; a scenario overrides them in its camera key. target = default view centre [x, y] in m, yaw/pitch = angle in °, distance = distance in m, zoom = [min, max] for the wheel, bounds = [x0, x1, y0, y1] where the view centre may go (equal values = no movement in that direction), pan_speed = pan speed (share of distance per s).

orders._info: Hero orders (to a place, at an enemy group, with an ally). Without an order and after finishing one the hero holds his place: fights whoever comes within hold_radius m of it and defends against whoever attacks him within twice that; a ranged hero shoots at range. To a place he goes without fighting (that is how a hero is pulled out of combat). At a group he fights only its members, first whoever is next to him (reach + on_way, ranged on_way_ranged). With an ally: stays within ally_dist m (ranged and healer ally_dist_back m behind) and fights whoever is within ally_guard m of the ally; whoever is farther from the ally than ally_dist + ally_guard + ally_leash m (say after a Charge) returns to him. settle = tolerance of a resting spot (against jitter). After Shadow Strike and Charge the hero stays on the target for at most focus_time s (while it lives and is within reach + focus_leash m), then returns to his order. melee_slots: at most this many melee enemies fight one hero at once, the others wait wait_gap m beyond reach. body_gap: bodies push apart to this multiple of their radii (1 = no overlap). hint_support: the auto-play hint uses Shadow Strike and Charge only on an enemy within this many m of another hero. Moving units walk around allies standing in their way within avoid_look m (strength avoid_strength). group_link = enemies of the same wave and the same fighting style (ranged, melee) within this many m of each other form a group.

abilities._info: Hero abilities. uses = uses per battle (fixed, not refilled between battle phases, restored after the battle), cooldown = recharge after use (s), target = none / point (a spot on the ground) / enemy, range = targeting range in m. Other numbers depend on the ability. power = numbers scaled by the hero's Power (×(1 + Power)); Haste shortens the cooldown (÷(1 + Haste)). New since 2.3d: hradba (heroes within radius take damage_taken, the tank is rooted), uder_stitem (stun in a cone in front: reach, stun, dmg), kruh (zone: foes slowed by slow, heroes heal hps per s), svetlo (blind: foes in radius cannot attack for duration), mirena (aimed shot mult × attack, interrupts a commander), ustup (leaps leap m back and shoots arrows × dmg), korouhev (heroes within radius attack +attack for duration), prujezd (rides through to a point, knocks foes aside by push, dmg), kour (smoke zone: heroes inside cannot be targeted, dps poison), noze (knives × dmg at the nearest foes within range). Optional numbers for refinements: slow, push, pierce, rout, recharge_on_kill, poison_t/poison_dps, vuln.

vyzva.name: Challenge

pozehnani.name: Blessing

najezd.name: Charge

uder.name: Shadow Strike

hradba.name: Bulwark

uder_stitem.name: Shield Bash
uder_stitem.desc: Stuns enemies up to 2.5 m in front of him for 2 s and hits them for 10.

svetlo.name: Holy Light
svetlo.desc: Enemies in a 3 m circle cannot attack for 3 s. Aimed up to 10 m.

mirena.name: Aimed Shot

ustup.name: Retreating Fire

korouhev.name: Banner
korouhev.desc: For 8 s heroes within 6 m get Attack +20 %.

prujezd.name: Ride Through

noze.name: Throwing Knives

passives._info: Hero passives and oaths (run rewards). class = class that can get it (any = anyone), kind = passive / oath (a hero has at most 1 oath), rod = house oath (anyone may take it, anyone without an oath inherits it; a personal oath is inherited only by the successor). stats = stat bonuses (utok = Attack, moc = Power, odolnost = Toughness, pohotovost = Haste, sila = Might), when = condition under which stats apply (allies_near, alone, moving, avenger, vs_ranged, vs_grudge, unseen). fits / clashes = abilities the oath works with / against (reason for the player; a test checks the ratio). Other keys depend on the passive. kind refine = refinement of one ability (ability = its key): only a hero with that ability can have it, it is lost when the ability is swapped (decision 05.11.2026).

ochrance.name: Guardian
ochrance.desc: An ally within 2 m takes 20 % less damage.

druhy_dech.name: Second Wind
druhy_dech.desc: Once per battle, at 30 % health, regains 25 % health.

hlasita_vyzva.name: Loud Challenge
hlasita_vyzva.desc: Challenge draws enemies within 9 m instead of 6.

posledni_pomazani.name: Last Rites

pozehnana_zbroj.name: Blessed Armor

probodnuti.name: Piercing Shot

rozbeh.name: Running Start

drtivy_najezd.name: Crushing Charge
drtivy_najezd.desc: The stun from Charge lasts 2.5 s.

ze_stinu.name: From the Shadows
ze_stinu.desc: The first blow against an enemy not attacking him deals double damage.

ukryt.name: Vanish
ukryt.desc: After Shadow Strike no one targets him for 2 s.

mstitel.name: Avenger
mstitel.desc: When an ally falls, Attack +30 % until the end of the battle.

fits.kruh: The circle goes down in the middle of the squad.
fits.korouhev: Banner strengthens heroes around him and keeps the squad together.

clashes.mirena: Aimed Shot at 15 m tempts him to stand far behind the squad.
clashes.ustup: The leap back takes him away from the squad.
clashes.najezd: Charge carries him away from the squad.
clashes.prujezd: Ride Through carries him past the group.
clashes.uder: The leap behind an enemy takes him far from the squad.

milost.desc: Might +25 %. Does not attack fleeing enemies; hitting one with an ability breaks the oath.

clashes.najezd: Charge rides through the fleeing too.

fits.mirena: Aimed Shot finishes even a strong target.

clashes.pozehnani: The priest hardly kills; the condition is hard to meet.
clashes.kruh: The priest hardly kills; the condition is hard to meet.
clashes.svetlo: The priest hardly kills; the condition is hard to meet.

ochrana.name: Oath of Protection
ochrana.power: Toughness +20 %. Takes half the damage of his ward within 3 m.
ochrana.restriction: If the ward (the priest, otherwise the weakest ally) falls, it breaks.

chudoba.desc: Power +40 %, but may not heal himself (not even with Blessing).

lovecka_cest.desc: Attack +20 %. Does not shoot enemies below 30 % health; hitting one with an ability breaks the oath.

bdelost.desc: Attack +40 % and range +40 %. Does not move once the battle starts; an order during battle breaks the oath.

clashes.ustup: The leap back is movement and breaks the oath.

samotar.name: Loner's Oath
samotar.power: Attack +30 % when no ally is within 4 m.
samotar.desc: Attack +30 % when no ally is within 4 m. May not have a bond.

rytirska_vyzva.name: Knightly Challenge
rytirska_vyzva.restriction: Strikes the commander first: until then attacks no one else; hitting another with an ability breaks it.
rytirska_vyzva.desc: Attack +30 %. Until his first blow lands on a commander he attacks no one else; hitting someone else first with an ability breaks the oath.

fits.najezd: Charge rides straight to the commander.

clashes.prujezd: Ride Through hits footmen before the commander.

nikdy_nestoji.desc: Attack +30 % while moving (and 1.5 s after). Standing still without fighting for 3 s while the enemy is awake breaks the oath.

clashes.korouhev: Banner wants him to stand by his allies.

korouhve.name: Oath of the Standard
korouhve.restriction: Stays within 8 m of the tank; straying for over 2 s breaks it.
korouhve.desc: +1 ability use. May not stray more than 8 m from the tank (for over 2 s), otherwise the oath is broken.

fits.korouhev: Banner by the tank strengthens the core of the squad.

clashes.najezd: Charge carries him away from the tank.

pomsta.name: Blood Debt
pomsta.power: Attack +40 % against whoever wounded an ally.
pomsta.restriction: While such an enemy lives, he goes after him and ignores orders.
pomsta.desc: Attack +40 % against whoever wounded an ally. While such an enemy lives, he goes after him and ignores orders.

stin.name: Oath of the Shadow
stin.power: Attack +100 % against an enemy not attacking him.
stin.restriction: Never attacks whoever attacks him; hitting one with an ability breaks it.
stin.desc: Attack +100 % against an enemy not attacking him. Does not attack whoever is attacking him; hitting one with an ability breaks the oath.

fits.uder: A leap behind the back is exactly an attack on the unaware.
fits.kour: In the smoke no one attacks him.

clashes.noze: Knives fly at the nearest, even at whoever attacks him.

prisaha_mlceni.name: Oath of Silence
prisaha_mlceni.restriction: Takes at most 3 orders per battle; the fourth breaks it.
prisaha_mlceni.desc: Haste +30 % and +1 ability use. Takes at most 3 orders per battle; the fourth breaks the oath.

fits.kour: Smoke is laid once; no orders needed.

odrazeni.name: Repel
odrazeni.desc: Shield Bash also throws enemies 1 m back.

rozhreseni.name: Absolution
rozhreseni.desc: Blessing also gives Attack +20 % for 5 s.

ocista.name: Purge
ocista.desc: Holy Light also interrupts a commander's ability.

pruraz.name: Breakthrough
pruraz.desc: Aimed Shot also hits enemies in a line behind the target (half).

zlomena_vule.name: Broken Will
zlomena_vule.desc: An enemy hit by Aimed Shot flees (not a commander).

rozdupani.name: Trample
rozdupani.desc: Ride Through hits each enemy for 10.

siroky_prujezd.name: Wide Ride
siroky_prujezd.desc: Ride Through sweeps a 3 m wide path.

stinovy_krok.name: Shadow Step
stinovy_krok.desc: A kill with Shadow Strike recharges it by half.

jedovaty_kour.name: Poison Smoke
jedovaty_kour.desc: Smoke burns enemies inside for 3 per second.

jed.name: Poisoned Blades
jed.desc: Knives poison for 4 s, 3 per second.

morale._info: Enemy morale. When the enemy loses break_losses of its units (fallen and fled), morale breaks and each unit reacts by on_break: desperate = fights to the end (attack + desperate_dmg_bonus), flee = runs off the edge of the field (flee_y in the scenario). A scenario may override break_losses. auto_charge_after = how many s after the break the heroes finish the fight on their own if the player does not give All In! (stalemate guard). decided_ratio = when one side's strength drops below this share of the other's, the heroes finish the fight on their own.

traits._info: Enemy traits. A unit has them in units.json (traits) or gets them in the scenario (4th element of the enemy row). never_breaks = never breaks, on_break = overrides the reaction to broken morale, desperate_dmg_bonus = extra attack when desperate.

zoufalec.name: Desperado
zoufalec.desc: With broken morale attacks 10 % harder on top.

fanatik.name: Fanatic
fanatik.desc: Never breaks, fights to the end.

zbabelec.name: Coward
zbabelec.desc: When morale breaks he flees, even as a footman.

stats._info: Hero stats. Bonuses are fractions (0.25 = +25 %). Might = Attack and Power at once. Keys stay Czech: utok = Attack, moc = Power, odolnost = Toughness, pohotovost = Haste, sila = Might.

utok.name: Attack
utok.desc: Damage of the basic attack; for Shadow Strike also of the ability.

moc.name: Power
moc.desc: Strength of the ability (the numbers in its power) and the priest's healing.

pohotovost.name: Haste
pohotovost.desc: Attack speed, priest healing speed and ability recharge.

sila.name: Might
sila.desc: Attack and Power at once (house oaths, relics).

bond_rules._info: Bonds between heroes (decision 07.11.2026). A pair that wins a battle with both surviving gets +1 shared victory. levels = shared victories needed for level 1, 2, 3. Level 1: the player picks the bond type from choices options. Combo from combo_level. Grief: level 1 is halved (grief_half), level 3 adds grief_sila Might until the end of the battle.

bonds._info: Bond types. who = [group A, group B]: one hero from A, the other from B ("*" = anyone); successor = one of the pair must be a successor (joined later). Numbers in a list are for level 1 / 2 / 3. desc = what it gives, grief_desc = grief when one falls.

bratri.name: Brothers in Arms
bratri.desc: Within 4 m of each other both get Attack +10 / 20 / 30 %.
bratri.grief_desc: The other rages for 8 s: Attack +40 %, ignores orders.

zpovednik.name: Confessor
zpovednik.grief_desc: The priest heals no one for 10 s.

stitonos.name: Shield-Bearer
stitonos.desc: The tank takes 15 / 30 / 40 % of his companion's damage within 3 m.
stitonos.grief_desc: The tank loses his remaining ability uses.

lovci.name: Hunting Pair
lovci.desc: The archer shoots the target of the assassin's Shadow Strike for 5 s at ×1.5 / ×2 / ×2.5.
lovci.grief_desc: The other gets Attack −20 % until the end of the battle.

kopi.name: Lance and Shield

krev.name: Blood Brothers

ucitel.name: Master and Pupil
ucitel.desc: The pupil within 5 m of the master gets Might +10 / 15 / 20 %.
ucitel.grief_desc: The pupil inherits one passive of the master.

souperi.name: Rivals
souperi.desc: Both Attack +10 / 15 / 20 %; whoever kills more in a battle brings the house +15 glory. Cost: he will not help his rival below 30 % health.

combos._info: Bond combos (decision 07.11.2026): two heroes with a bond of at least combo_level, their abilities a and b. Fires both at once (Q, E), uses one charge of each and starts both recharging. aim = none (anchor = hero with ability a) / point / enemy (aimed with ability aim_by). max_gap = how far apart the heroes may be.

navnada.name: Bait
navnada.desc: The tank challenges the enemies and a Volley lands on those around him, damage +50 %.

za_zady.name: From Behind

stit_a_kopi.name: Shield and Lance
stit_a_kopi.desc: The tank challenges the enemies and the cavalier rides through those drawn in to reach him, Charge +50 %.

posvecene_sipy.name: Hallowed Arrows
posvecene_sipy.desc: Volley burns enemies +30 % and heals heroes in a 4 m circle by 10 %.

kladivo.name: Hammer and Anvil
kladivo.desc: The cavalier rides through, the assassin leaps behind the first one stunned: kills a footman, strikes a commander ×4.

phradba.name: Blessed Bulwark
phradba.desc: Bulwark around the tank and a Blessing inside it that heals double.

svatyne.name: Sanctuary

zastava.name: Banner of Faith
